messages:
ana: quick, need a knife-edge sanity run for Friday launch and webinar. were calling four headline metrics: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, long-context tail probe, and a tiny stability delta for quantized-n4 vs float16.

sam: copy. region? artifacts?

ana: us-west-2. artifacts: latencies.csv (per-request), heatmap PNG, 12 sample outputs (4 per prompt), and a short manifest with model hash + seeds + command snippet. exclude full KV dumps.

leo: traffic profile? coldstart induction?

ana: smoke: 50 qps for 6m measurement, warmup matrix: (A) 90s, (B) 3m — include both buckets. induce 3 coldstarts during measurement by restarting workers. compare quantized-n4 and float16 baseline.

maria: methodology blurb: one paragraph with seeds, RNG, infra, and a 1-line CSV header for the deck. tag dataset id on S3.

sam: plan: staging cluster run, seeds 13,37,101, warmup matrix + measurement windows, record token-level latencies + GPU util. s3 prefix: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1809999991-knife-edge/. will include reproducible CLI in manifest.

leo: note: quantized-n4 shows warmup sensitivity. warmup-bucketed numbers will help explain marketing delta.

benchbot: Scheduled run rb-1809999991 on staging for 2024-07-12T03:00:00Z. ETA artifacts ~35m after run.

sam: running now.

benchbot: rb-1809999991 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1809999991-knife-edge/{manifest.json,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json}. Summary (meas window): quantized-n4 p95=74ms p99=225ms (90s warmup); when 3m warmup p99 drops to 185ms. float16 baseline p95=66ms p99=170ms. coldstart first-token spike ~0.82s.

maria: grabbing artifacts. will craft the blurb and add an explanatory bullet: "quantized variants can show higher tails under short warmup; numbers reported with warmup=90s unless noted."

ana: perfect. flag any regression >15% vs last public run. if >15%, mark for eng rerun.

sam: quick diff: quantized-n4 p99 up 18% vs last week at same warmup; suspect a changed warmup sequence in staging. will investigate and potentially do a longer-warmup rerun if needed.

ana: ok hold on rerun until eng confirms cause. thanks all :sparkles:
